gaps.explanation: No fund column missing, nothing counted twice; the whole difference is the report's own printed budget-to-GAAP accrual adjustments. Per fund, statement p5 (printed p23) Total revenues vs detail: General Fund 9,021,109 vs budget schedule p12 (printed p59) Total revenues 8,270,885 = +750,224 = 'Accrual adjustment for receivables 750,224' printed in the General Fund budget-to-GAAP reconciliation p11 (printed p58). Street Fund 1,843,878 vs budget schedule p13 (printed p60) Total revenues 3,675,394 = -1,831,516 = 'Accrual adjustments for receivables (1,798,473)' printed on p14 (printed p61) less 33,043 of that same adjustment that falls on transfers in (GAAP transfers in 5,340,196 p5 vs budget 5,307,153 p14): budget revenues 3,675,394 + insurance proceeds 9,717 + transfers in 5,307,153 - 1,798,473 = 7,193,791 = GAAP 1,843,878 + 9,717 + 5,340,196. The Street budget revenues include 'Warrant income' 1,581,498, which the GAAP Street column does not show as revenue. Keno Fund 136,683 vs budget p15 (printed p62) 134,574 = +2,109 = 'Accrual adjustment for receivables 2,109' printed on p15. Debt Service 855,485 and Other Governmental Funds (TIF 2/4/5/6/7, p17) 318,420 = detail exactly. 750,224 - 1,831,516 + 2,109 = -1,079,183 = gap. The GAAP General Fund combining statement p16 (printed p66) is not added because the General Fund is already in detail from its budget schedule.

Per fund, statement p5 Total expenditures vs detail: General Fund 5,562,133 vs budget p10 (printed p57) Total expenditures 5,539,750 = +22,383 = 'Accrual adjustments for payables (22,383)' printed p11. Street Fund 4,686,271 vs detail Street lines 8,368,066 = -3,681,795: the budget schedule p13 prints Total expenditures 8,429,946 and 'Accrual adjustments for payables 3,743,675' on p14 (8,429,946 - 3,743,675 = 4,686,271 = GAAP), and the report's own Street actual lines add to 8,368,066, 61,880 less than its printed total (report_discrepancies; lines kept as printed): -3,743,675 + 61,880 = -3,681,795. The Street budget 'Debt Service' 3,775,273 vs GAAP Street principal 22,159 + interest 3,755 is where that payables adjustment sits. Keno 33,034 = 33,034; Debt Service 679,998 and TIF funds 323,573 = detail exactly. 22,383 - 3,681,795 = -3,659,412 = gap. Printed basis difference; nothing to add or remove.

Statement p5 Operating transfers - in: General 2,365,579, Debt Service 143,109, Street 5,340,196, Other Governmental (TIF 4) 176,500 = 8,025,384. Detail: General 2,365,579 (p10), Debt Service 143,109 (p5), TIF 4 176,500 (p17), Street budget p14 'Operating transfers - in' 5,307,153 = 7,992,341. Difference 33,043 = Street GAAP 5,340,196 - budget 5,307,153, part of the Street Fund's printed 'Accrual adjustments for receivables (1,798,473)' (p14; see revenue entry). Adding the GAAP Street transfer would give the Street Fund two transfer lines; nothing added.

Detail holds the statement's bond proceeds exactly: Debt Service 'Proceeds from issuance of bonds' 5,726,322 (p5) = JSON debt_proceeds 5,726,322. The other 1,591,215 counted by the gap check is (a) Street Fund budget 'Warrant income' 1,581,498, printed among Street REVENUES on the budget schedule p13 (printed p60) and kept there as printed (section revenue); the GAAP Street column p5 prints no proceeds row (the budget-to-GAAP adjustments on p14 absorb it), and (b) Street 'Insurance proceeds' 9,717 (p14, also p5 Street column), which is an other-financing row and is in JSON other_financing 424,174 (= Sale of assets 414,457 + Insurance proceeds 9,717), not a debt row. Governmental non-transfer other-financing detail = 5,726,322 + sale of assets 250,257 + 164,200 + insurance 9,717 = 6,150,496 = debt_proceeds 5,726,322 + other_financing 424,174. Nothing missing.
